## What it is

WeGoTrip sells this as a self-guided tour in Barcelona, Spain. It starts at Passeig de Gràcia.

## How WeGoTrip describes it

> Explore Casa Batlló by Antoni Gaudí with the Platinum Ticket. Enjoy skipping the lines with priority access to this modernist masterpiece. As a UNESCO World Heritage site, Casa Batlló is celebrated for its distinctive architecture.
>
> You will have access to all areas, including the roof terrace designed to resemble the scaled-back of a dragon.
>
> During your visit, immerse yourself in the Gaudí Dome, where a mesmerizing display of lights and sounds captures Gaudí's inspirations.
>
> Make sure to see the Gaudí Cube, a 360-degree video installation that offers fresh insights into Gaudí’s creative vision. Both attractions enhance your understanding of his innovative approach to art and design.

## Price and rating

On 13 November 2026, WeGoTrip's product data listed it from €62.37. It was rated 4.9 out of 5 from 144 ratings and 60 written reviews. The final price is shown at WeGoTrip's checkout.

## Where this page comes from

This page was built on 13 November 2026 from WeGoTrip's partner data, the product information WeGoTrip gives its affiliates. We have not taken this tour ourselves, so check the listing for anything that matters to you before you book.
